description: This file defines the public interface for FreeType renderer modules, including function pointer types, structures, and functions related to glyph rendering, transformation, and module management within the FreeType library.

classes.name: FT_Glyph_Class_
classes.description: Structure defining glyph object behavior and properties within FreeType.

classes.name: FT_Renderer_Class_
classes.description: Structure defining renderer module class descriptor, including rendering and transformation functions.

methods.name: FT_Get_Renderer
methods.description: Retrieves the current renderer for a specified glyph format.

methods.name: FT_Set_Renderer
methods.description: Sets the current renderer to use for glyph rendering with optional parameters.
